name: Syria

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of green, white and black, with three red five-pointed stars in a row across the white stripe.
flag.symbolism: Green, white and black are Pan-Arab colors associated with historic Arab dynasties, and the three red stars are commonly said to represent the regions united in the Syrian Republic of the 1930s.

hook: Syria's flag starts green on top with three red stars on white; Iraq, Egypt and Yemen all start red on top.
trivia: This design was first adopted in 1932 and was used until 1958 and again from 1961 to 1963.
It was readopted in December 2024, replacing the red-white-black flag with two green stars that had been used since 1980.
Damascus is often cited as one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world.
